facts.title: Oldest Desert on Earth
facts.description: Namibia's Namib is the world's oldest desert — elephants, rhinos, and lions survive in its dunes and gravel plains.

facts.title: Africa's Flagship Safari
facts.description: South Africa's Kruger National Park protects nearly 2 million hectares — one of the continent's best self-drive Big Five destinations.

facts.title: Largest Inland Delta
facts.description: Botswana's Okavango Delta floods each year from Angolan rains — 22,000 km² of channels, islands, and wildlife.

facts.title: Smoke That Thunders
facts.description: Victoria Falls creates a mist visible for kilometres. Locals call it Mosi-oa-Tunya — the smoke that thunders.

facts.title: UNESCO Wilderness Walks
facts.description: Zimbabwe's Mana Pools is one of few parks where experienced visitors can walk among elephants on the Zambezi floodplain.

facts.title: Gorongosa Reborn
facts.description: Mozambique's Gorongosa National Park is one of Africa's great conservation comebacks — lions and elephants thriving again.

facts.title: The Calendar Lake
facts.description: Lake Malawi stretches roughly 365 miles by 52 miles wide — a UNESCO freshwater sea with over 1,000 cichlid species.

facts.title: Kingdom in the Sky
facts.description: Lesotho is the only country entirely above 1,000 metres — mountain passes, pony treks, and winter snow.

facts.title: Africa's Last Absolute Monarchy
facts.description: Eswatini preserves Swazi culture through events like the Umhlanga Reed Dance and community-run game reserves.

topDestinations.name: Kruger National Park
topDestinations.desc: Africa's flagship self-drive safari — Big Five, 500+ birds, and vast bushveld wilderness.

topDestinations.name: Etosha National Park
topDestinations.desc: Legendary waterhole viewing around a vast salt pan — one of Africa's greatest game parks.

topDestinations.name: Okavango Delta
topDestinations.desc: UNESCO wetland wilderness — mokoro safaris through papyrus channels teeming with wildlife.

topDestinations.name: Victoria Falls
topDestinations.desc: One of the Seven Natural Wonders — thundering cascades on the Zambia–Zimbabwe border.

topDestinations.name: Hwange National Park
topDestinations.desc: Massive elephant herds and excellent predator viewing — pairs perfectly with Victoria Falls.

topDestinations.name: Bazaruto Archipelago
topDestinations.desc: Turquoise Indian Ocean islands — dugongs, whale sharks, and world-class diving.

topDestinations.name: Lake Malawi
topDestinations.desc: Crystal-clear freshwater, golden beaches, and snorkelling among colourful cichlids.

topDestinations.name: Sani Pass & Highlands
topDestinations.desc: Dramatic mountain pass from KwaZulu-Natal into the Kingdom in the Sky.

topDestinations.name: Hlane Royal National Park
topDestinations.desc: Eswatini's largest reserve — lions, rhinos, and guided drives in royal bushveld.

travelNews.title: South Africa power grid stabilises — 400+ days without load shedding
travelNews.excerpt: Eskom reports sustained generation recovery through winter 2026. Tourist hubs and lodges largely unaffected, but localised load reduction may still hit some townships — confirm backup power when self-catering.

travelNews.title: KAZA UniVisa extended at Victoria Falls crossings
travelNews.excerpt: The $50 UniVisa continues to cover multiple entries between Zambia and Zimbabwe, including day trips to Botswana's Chobe National Park via Kazungula.

travelNews.title: Namibia visa rules updated from 1 April 2025
travelNews.excerpt: Many nationals (including UK, US, EU, and Australia) now need an e-visa or visa-on-arrival. SADC visitors are often still exempt — confirm on mha.gov.na before travel.

travelNews.title: Gorongosa reports record predator sightings
travelNews.excerpt: Mozambique's restored wilderness continues its remarkable recovery — lion and elephant populations reach new highs.

travelNews.title: Kazungula Bridge cuts Chobe crossing times
travelNews.excerpt: The modern bridge linking Botswana, Zambia, and Zimbabwe has replaced the slow pontoon — plan Victoria Falls circuit day trips with confidence.

travelNews.title: Herero Living Museum opens in Otjokavare
travelNews.excerpt: A new cultural experience in northwest Namibia offers immersive insight into Herero traditions, dress, and daily life.

travelNews.title: Self-drive season peaks across Southern Africa
travelNews.excerpt: Dry-season wildlife viewing (May–October) is underway — book park accommodation and 4x4 rentals early for peak months.

travelNews.title: Cape Town–Windhoek and JNB–Maun routes add mid-week capacity
travelNews.excerpt: Airlink and Air Botswana expanded mid-week frequencies for winter 2026 — useful for open-jaw self-drive loops between Namibia and Botswana.

travelNews.title: Okavango Delta flood levels reach 5-year high
travelNews.excerpt: Water levels in the Okavango are exceptional for mokoro season — some camps report extended channel access into July.

travelNews.title: Zimbabwe e-visa portal adds same-day Victoria Falls entries
travelNews.excerpt: Online visa applications for many nationalities now offer faster processing for Victoria Falls Airport and Kazungula land border.

travelNews.title: Umhlanga Reed Dance dates confirmed for Eswatini
travelNews.excerpt: The annual cultural ceremony typically draws visitors in late August — combine with Kruger or Hlane for a lowveld loop.

travelNews.title: Malawi lakeshore road upgrade completes M5 southern section
travelNews.excerpt: Improved tarmac between Mangochi and Cape Maclear reduces drive times from Lilongwe — useful for lake-to-safari combos via Liwonde.
